data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, the goddess Ceres carried her son, Perseus, in a chest or 'case' during his childhood. The name Case can be derived from the Greek word 'kasos', meaning 'box' or 'container'. The name Case carries the meaning “Box, container” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Case usually hope their child will grow to embody box, container and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Κάση
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κάση έχει σχέση με τη λέξη θήκη ή περίβλημα. Στην ελληνική γλώσσα, το όνομα μπορεί να συσχετιστεί με την προστασία ή τη φύλαξη κάτι πολύτιμου. This name serves as a reminder of our spiritual journey and our role as vessels carrying the love of Christ to the world.
